title: UFO MP- 1766, 1766 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: high relief, antique finish, selective copper plating, resin fill, fluorescent paint, digital printing

descriptionPlain: Description Seven ounces of pure silver Futuristic numismatic design Exclusive, dedicated packaging High-end decorative techniques Discover a new dimension in numismatic art with the „UFO MP-1766” coin. Unveiled at the 20th World Money Fair in Berlin, this innovative piece blends futuristic technology with modern aesthetics, redefining traditional coin minting. Symbolizing both mystery and advancement, its unique design and advanced crafting techniques make it a standout addition to any collection, embodying the spirit of progress and creativity in the numismatic world.
